name: security-scan
description: Run security scanners (npm audit, ESLint security rules) and report vulnerabilities categorized by severity (critical, high, moderate, low). Checks for known CVEs in dependencies.

inputs.name: fix
inputs.description: If true, run npm audit fix. Default: false.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Security report: vulnerabilityCount, severity breakdown, affectedPackages, fixable count.

failureConditions.signal: command exits with 'npm audit not available'
